body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: cc9a11da919703d8cf11dce60bb83312aa80f06e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (mind the stack, note 1).

**What looks good**
- The change is small and does what the body says: `Work::attempt()` (`adaptive/budget.rs`) resets the law-2 length and law-3 vertex sums, called once at the top of `Planner::grow` (`grow.rs`). Limits, law 1 and every refusal text are unchanged.
- A budget overrun still refuses, never emits a partial path: the new default-suite test `each_margin_attempt_is_held_to_the_budget_on_its_own` asserts the "planning budget after N revolutions" and "both limits passed" refusals still fire per attempt. The "never hang" bound is stated (three rungs x limit).
- No golden file, snapshot PNG, process file, build.rs, `.github`, script or dependency is touched. No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests (the `panic!`s in budget.rs are in `#[cfg(test)]` let-else arms).
- Verdict changes (r7 bar level 5.0, window levels 6.0/5.0 refused -> HSM-planned) are explained in the body and pinned in `rotary_adaptive`; the end-kink caveat (#1050/#882) is disclosed honestly.
- Decision file present, `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #1051` present, provenance headers on the new module, files under 400 lines.

**Local results** (PR head trial-merged with upstream/main d595f0e0, merge clean, debug, macOS)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-motion lib | 216 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored |
| adaptive_band | 2 passed |
| adaptive_hsm | 1 passed, 5 ignored (heavy lane) |
| adaptive_orbit_seam | 1 passed |
| pocket3d_hsm (motion) | 3 passed, 1 ignored |
| rotary_adaptive | 3 passed, 3 ignored |
| offset_shells | 6 passed, 1 ignored |
| tiny_step | 3 passed |
| machining2d | 66 passed |
| app golden_cl | 26 passed (no golden moved) |
| app operations | 119 passed, 6 ignored |
| app pocket3d_hsm | 1 passed, 1 ignored |
| clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

Not run here: the `--ignored` heavy lanes (twins, rotary_adaptive levels, adaptive_hsm island) - release-lane, the author reports them green on 5516dbc3 (head since moved by a main merge only).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Stacked: the body says stacked on #1080 (#982), which is still open, so the diff against main carries its commits (lift.rs, lift_coarse.rs, rings.rs, ...) beyond this PR's own `budget*.rs`, `grow.rs`, `rotary_adaptive.rs` and decision file. Merging #1138 first would land #1080's code with it; merge #1080 first (or retarget), as the AGENTS.md stacking rule says.
2. A plan near the limit can still turn on nanometres which margin attempt it lands in; the body discloses that the posted plans differ (5 in-cut breaks <= 6.2 deg at level 5.0 for the first-margin plan, #1050). Only Linux x86-64 was measured by the author.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
